items.author: The Stacks Project Authors

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes H^0 and the genus of a plane curve of degree d (statement lines 1904-1909). The proof (lines 1911-1939) is complete: the graded sequence, its sheafification, the cohomology comparison to the ambient projective space, and the long-exact identification of H^0 with k and H^1 with a graded piece of dimension (d - 1)(d - 2)/2. Every step is present with no omissions. H2: a standard cohomological computation with correctly ordered inputs.
